Product Range

Shrimp Paste

Selected from premium white Vannamei shrimp, this is handcrafted and contains over 90/95% real shrimp meat. It delivers a bouncy, crisp texture with a rich shrimp flavor, making it the perfect ingredient for hotpot, soups, and pan-frying.

Marinated Snakehead Fish Slices

Selected from premium snakehead fish, these are pre-marinated with an exclusive recipe. The thin, intact fillets are silky, tender, and crisp. No extra starch is required—ready to use instantly for Sichuan Spicy Boiled Fish.

Dory/Basa Fish Slices

Selected from premium Vietnam Dory/Basa fish, these fillets are boneless and skinless, featuring pure white and delicate meat. Pre-seasoned and marinated, they deliver a tender, flavorful, and silky texture—making them a highly cost-effective and ideal ingredient Sichuan Spicy Boiled Fish.

Grass Carp

Specially selected from uniquely diet-fed crispy grass carp, the meat is firm, springy, crisp, and chewy, staying intact even after long cooking. The fish is finely sliced and pre-marinated for maximum flavor—simply thaw and cook. Perfect for hotpot and stir-fry.

Butterfly-Cut Channel Catfish

Selected from premium Qingjiang fish, these are meticulously descaled, gilled, gutted, and butterflied. The fish is clean, featuring delicate, silky meat with no small bones—making it the ultimate choice for signature grilled fish dishes.

Butterfly-Cut Dory/Basa Fish

Selected from premium imported Vietnam Dory/Basa fish, these feature a butterfly cut for rapid marinating and even grilling. The meat is plump and succulent, pairing perfectly with spicy, garlic, or various flavors.

Crabsticks (Kanikama)

Fish Cake

Fish Ball

When fried, it turns golden, crispy, and savory—making it a uniquely flavorful snack. It can also be flash-boiled in hotpots or served as a cold salad, offering a smooth, springy texture that adds rich layers of flavor to any meal.

French Fries
